create_attrdict_from_dict: create an AttrDict instance from a plain Python dictionary with nested dict support
access_attrdict_with_dot_notation: access nested dictionary values using dot notation instead of bracket notation
add_entries_to_attrdict: merge new key-value pairs into an existing AttrDict with optional overwrite behavior
serialize_attrdict_to_json: serialize an AttrDict instance to a formatted JSON string using the serialize method
iterate_attrdict_items: iterate over AttrDict key-value pairs using items, keys, or values methods
